notes.title: Graveyard Gunslingers playtest registration is OPEN!
notes.content: Playtest registration is finally open! Request access and hopefully, you will be chosen to play the game! Playtest begins December 1st (Friday) and lasts throughout the weekend till December 3rd(Sunday).
